systems_found: Rhode Island public higher education (Council on Postsecondary Education / Office of the Postsecondary Commissioner): University of Rhode Island, Rhode Island College, Community College of Rhode Island

sources.institution: University of Rhode Island, Rhode Island College, Community College of Rhode Island, Office of Higher Education, plus all state agencies
sources.system: State of Rhode Island Transparency Portal - RI State Employee Payroll
sources.coverage_years: FY2011-FY2026 (FY2026 partial; page says last updated October 9, 2025)
sources.institutions_covered: Department values include 'U R I', 'R I COLLEGE', 'COMMUNITY COLLEGE OF R I', 'HIGHER EDUCATION', 'STATE COLLEGES', 'RIHEAA', and all executive, judicial and legislative agencies
sources.employees: all state-paid employees (classified and non-classified), including terminated employees with a termination date
sources.format: CSV (single 'complete list' export, all years in one file; served as application/vnd.ms-excel with a .csv filename)
sources.update_frequency: quarterly in principle; stalled since 2025-10-09 during the state's payroll-system transition (per Rhode Island Current, Sept 2026)
sources.size: not stated (streamed, chunked; likely tens of MB covering about 16 fiscal years)
sources.notes: Excellent: one GET returns every year, with regular/overtime/other/total split and annual salary. Checked with a HEAD request and by reading the first 1.5KB only. Caveats: many faculty and professional staff carry the generic title 'NON CLASSIFIED' instead of a real job title; there is no department below agency level (e.g. just 'U R I'); the CSV uses comma-plus-space delimiters with a trailing comma. Data is stale after Oct 2025; newer payroll is available only by APRA request. robots.txt names only Googlebot and archive bots, so not restrictive.
Historical only and superseded by the official portal. Not checked further.

private_extra: None found; Brown University, Providence College, Bryant, RISD etc. publish only IRS 990 data.
gaps: Official file not refreshed since 2025-10-09 (FY2026 incomplete; nothing for FY2027 yet). Generic 'NON CLASSIFIED' titles for most faculty and non-classified staff. No department/college detail inside each institution.
notes: Only three public institutions, all covered by the one statewide file, so I did not look for separate campus sources.
